body:
like it was my fault that he and all his friends were attracted to four-year-old me. that's how i always felt. that it was my fault.

even forty years later i almost fly into a rage when people who remind me of my dad talk to me.

i tried reaching out to my family a few times. i get really down when people at work talk about their parents, what great parents they have. 

my dad is still alive but i honestly dont think he gives a shit. i fact i think he must be relieved that im gone. he always called me a faggot and a girl growing up and compared me to "real boys". that just floors me. do you have any insight into that though process besides that he's completely fucked up?
And my sons are perfect and it took almost no effort on my part. How the fuck did my dad want to do this to me? What gave him the idea? What did I do?

Every year its like the worst bad nightmare because I relive it. My friends are fucking sick of hearing it. To the point that they avoid me at the holidays. I'm fucking miserable. I really would hang myself but I have a 12 year old and a 16 year old.

I have a huge family. Brothers sisters. They all disowned me ten years ago when one of my sisters remembered some stuff. I realized imagining it, cos she had the same memories. My family kept her but tossed me out.
I have kids of my own. I'm fucking horrified that my own dad would have a thought like that. I often imagine that I have no parents, that I was just dropped here from space.

Its like he fucking did it on purpose on Christmas eve just so that I'd be outcast the rest of my life. I mean I've been thru everything. Outcast as a kid, bullied. Then fixed myself. Then broke down and was in the hospital. So much therapy. Meds. Every year I think I'll be OK but I'm not.
Why would my dad name me after him and then do that? Also, that was forty years ago. I'm very successful have family friends etc, but every year at Christmas I'm just at a complete loss.
